sections.h2: 1. Compare the code with the Black Friday price
parts: Yose Power's home page showed a Black Friday sale of up to 15% off kits and batteries, ending November 30. Many products already show a lower sale price, like the 27.5" rear kit at €379 instead of €429. Most shops take either a sale price or a code, not both, so put the item in your cart, enter {code} and see whether the total drops. One catch: Yose Power's refund policy says sale items can't be returned, only full-price items.

sections.h2: 2. Pick the battery size you need
parts: The Hailong down tube battery costs €208 for 15.6Ah (577Wh), €224 for 17.4Ah (644Wh) and €259 for 20Ah (740Wh). The bigger packs cost more but give more watt-hours per euro: about 2.8Wh per euro at 15.6Ah, against 2.9Wh at 17.4Ah and 20Ah. Yose Power lists an 18-month warranty on the battery and 12 months on the charger.

sections.h2: 3. Buy a kit with the battery included
parts: The 20" front motor kit costs €219 without a battery, and the Hailong battery alone starts at €208. Kits that already include a battery and charger, like the 27.5" rear kit with a 13Ah battery at €379, cost less than buying a motor kit and a battery separately. Check your wheel size, fork or dropout width (100mm front, 138mm rear on these kits) and brake type first: each product page lists them.

Yose Power says shipping is free across Europe. Batteries and kits leave its Berlin warehouse within 1 to 2 working days; delivery takes 2 to 4 working days in Germany and longer elsewhere in Europe. Some accessories ship from warehouses outside Germany. Every parcel has tracking.

You can return a new, unused product in its original packaging within 30 days, with proof of purchase. Email service@yosepower.com for the return address first. You pay return shipping unless the item was wrong or damaged, and sale items can't be returned. Refunds are made within 48 working hours of the return being confirmed, Yose Power says.
